title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
comment:
There is an aspect of altruism to creating infrastructure. The game is intended to be played online and any infrastructure you're building is actually going towards helping other players. That road that you're building may appear in someone else's game, making their playthrough quite a bit easier.

I think a lot of people missed this and played through the entire game wondering why it wasn't helping them in their playthroughs.

title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
comment: I built the infrastructure first thing and, despite how it might seem, it was actually very satisfying. That might be because I'm more of an engineer type than anything, though?

title: Death Stranding is one the greatest open world experiences ever created
comment: This was my experience too, particularly when you got into the post-game. It's nothing but generic repeatable side quests by then, and anything you unlock from doing those just makes the "walking simulator" part easier, which I felt kind of defeated the whole purpose of making the core gameplay a walking simulator to begin with.
